question.problem:
Find the equation of the tangent line to the polar curve $r=1-2\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta $ at $\theta =\pi ,$ given that

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{′}(\theta )=\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta -2\operatorname{sin}⁡(2\theta ),\,{x}^{′}(\theta )=-\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta -2\operatorname{cos}⁡(2\theta ).\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
To find the equation of the tangent line to a polar curve at a point $P,$ we follow four steps:

**Step 1**: Calculate the derivative $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}:$

In this case, we're given that

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{′}(\theta )=\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta -2\operatorname{sin}⁡(2\theta ),\,{x}^{′}(\theta )=-\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta -2\operatorname{cos}⁡(2\theta ).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we can find $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{{y}^{′}(\theta )}{{x}^{′}(\theta )} \\  & =\frac{\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta -2\operatorname{sin}⁡(2\theta )}{-\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta -2\operatorname{cos}⁡(2\theta )}\end{aligned}
$$

**Step 2**: Find the slope of the tangent at $P:$

The slope of the tangent line is

$$
\begin{aligned}m & ={\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}|}_{\theta =\pi } \\  & =\frac{\operatorname{cos}⁡\pi -2\operatorname{sin}⁡(2\pi )}{-\operatorname{sin}⁡\pi -2\operatorname{cos}⁡(2\pi )} \\  & =\frac{-1-2\cdot 0}{-0-2\cdot 1} \\  & =\frac{-1}{-2} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

**Step 3**: Find the Cartesian coordinates of $P:$

We compute the $xy$-coordinates of $P$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & =r\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  \\  & =(1-2\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta )\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  \\  & =(1-2\operatorname{sin}⁡\pi )\operatorname{cos}⁡\pi  \\  & =(1-0)\cdot (-1) \\  & =-1 \\ {y}_{1} & =r\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta  \\  & =(1-2\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta )\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta  \\  & =(1-2\operatorname{sin}⁡\pi )\operatorname{sin}⁡\pi  \\  & =(1-0)\cdot 0 \\  & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the coordinates of $P$ are $(-1,0).$

**Step 4**: Using point-slope form, find the equation of the tangent:

We find the equation of the tangent as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}y-{y}_{1} & =m(x-{x}_{1}) \\ y-0 & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot (x-(-1)) \\ y-0 & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot (x+1) \\ y & =\frac{1}{2}x+\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$
